easy: Being a natural, basic part of what something is.

ex.en: Kindness is an intrinsic part of who she is.
ex.ko: 친절함은 그녀라는 사람의 본질적인 부분이다.

easy: So strong that you cannot stop it or say no.
ko: 저항할 수 없는, 억누를 수 없는

ex.en: The smell of fresh cookies was irresistible.
ex.ko: 갓 구운 쿠키 냄새는 도저히 거부할 수 없었다.

easy: So nice or cute that you really want it.

ex.en: The puppy's face was irresistible.
ex.ko: 그 강아지의 얼굴은 너무 귀여워서 거부할 수 없었다.

easy: A small amount of computer information, about one thousand bytes.

ex.en: The small picture file was only 50 KB.
ex.ko: 그 작은 그림 파일은 겨우 50킬로바이트였다.

easy: A flat screen that shows numbers and pictures, like on a watch or calculator.

ex.en: My calculator has a small LCD screen.
ex.ko: 내 계산기에는 작은 액정 화면이 있다.

easy: Big changes that make something look new and much better.

ex.en: Our class gave the old library a makeover.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 낡은 도서관을 새롭게 탈바꿈시켰다.

easy: Having people on board to run it.

ex.en: The manned rocket flew around the moon.
ex.ko: 유인 로켓이 달 주위를 돌았다.

easy: A make-believe sea creature that is half girl and half fish.

ex.en: The mermaid swam past the colorful coral.
ex.ko: 인어가 알록달록한 산호 옆을 헤엄쳐 지나갔다.

easy: Not doing too much or too little of something.

ex.en: Candy is fine in moderation.
ex.ko: 사탕은 적당히 먹으면 괜찮다.

easy: Having to do with the country of Morocco in Africa or its people.

ex.en: We ate Moroccan food at a restaurant.
ex.ko: 우리는 식당에서 모로코 음식을 먹었다.

easy: A person who comes from Morocco.

ex.en: A Moroccan sat next to me on the plane.
ex.ko: 비행기에서 모로코 사람이 내 옆에 앉았다.

easy: The group of rich families in old times who had special titles, like lords and ladies.

ex.en: The king invited the nobility to the party.
ex.ko: 왕은 귀족들을 파티에 초대했다.

easy: Being good, kind, and brave in a very high way.

ex.en: She showed great nobility by sharing her lunch.
ex.ko: 그녀는 점심을 나눠 주며 고결한 마음을 보여 주었다.

easy: A set of signs or symbols used to write down things like music or math.

ex.en: Music notation uses dots and lines to show notes.
ex.ko: 악보 표기법은 점과 선으로 음을 나타낸다.

easy: A short written comment that explains something.

ex.en: The teacher wrote a notation in the margin of my paper.
ex.ko: 선생님이 내 시험지 여백에 짧은 설명을 적어 주셨다.

easy: Happening on the part of the stage that the audience can see.

ex.en: The onstage dancers wore red costumes.
ex.ko: 무대 위의 무용수들은 빨간 의상을 입고 있었다.

easy: On the place where actors perform for the audience.

ex.en: I was nervous when I walked onstage.
ex.ko: 무대 위로 걸어 나갈 때 나는 긴장했다.

easy: A very hard and scary time that is hard to get through.

ex.en: Getting lost in the forest was a real ordeal.
ex.ko: 숲에서 길을 잃은 것은 정말 힘든 시련이었다.

easy: A big strong farm animal that is used to pull heavy loads.

ex.en: The farmer used an ox to pull the cart.
ex.ko: 농부는 소를 이용해 수레를 끌었다.

easy: In a way that is so bad or strong that it makes you uncomfortable.

ex.en: The shy boy was painfully quiet.
ex.ko: 그 수줍은 소년은 안쓰러울 정도로 조용했다.

easy: In a way that shows something hurts.

ex.en: He walked painfully on his hurt foot.
ex.ko: 그는 다친 발로 고통스럽게 걸었다.

easy: Not able to be explained by normal ways of seeing or hearing, like ghosts or mind-reading.

ex.en: She loves stories about paranormal things like ghosts.
ex.ko: 그녀는 유령 같은 초자연적인 이야기를 좋아한다.

easy: Strange and not explained by science.

ex.en: The kids told paranormal stories around the campfire.
ex.ko: 아이들은 캠프파이어 주위에서 초자연적인 이야기를 했다.

easy: A sweet, juicy fruit that is round at the bottom and thin at the top.

ex.en: I packed a green pear in my lunch.
ex.ko: 나는 도시락에 초록색 배를 넣었다.

easy: A tree that grows sweet, juicy fruit with a round bottom and thin top.

ex.en: A pear tree grows in our backyard.
ex.ko: 우리 뒷마당에는 배나무가 자란다.

easy: A part inside an engine that moves up and down to make it work.

ex.en: The pistons in a car engine move up and down.
ex.ko: 자동차 엔진 속 피스톤은 위아래로 움직인다.

easy: In a nice way that shows good manners.

ex.en: She politely said thank you to the bus driver.
ex.ko: 그녀는 버스 기사님께 공손하게 감사 인사를 했다.

easy: Making you feel upset or angry.

ex.en: The slow internet was very provoking.
ex.ko: 느린 인터넷 때문에 정말 짜증이 났다.

easy: A run that scores because of what the baseball batter did.

ex.en: Jake hit a single and got an RBI.
ex.ko: 제이크는 안타를 쳐서 타점을 올렸다.

easy: Music from Jamaica with a steady, bouncy beat.

ex.en: We danced to reggae at the beach party.
ex.ko: 우리는 해변 파티에서 레게 음악에 맞춰 춤을 췄다.

easy: In a way that shows you honor and care about someone.

ex.en: He listened respectfully to his grandfather.
ex.ko: 그는 할아버지의 말씀을 공손히 들었다.

easy: To think about a choice again and maybe change your mind.

ex.en: I had to rethink my plan when it started to rain.
ex.ko: 비가 오기 시작해서 나는 계획을 다시 생각해야 했다.

easy: To write something again in a different way.

ex.en: I had to rewrite my story to fix the mistakes.
ex.ko: 나는 실수를 고치려고 이야기를 다시 써야 했다.

easy: To change a story so it works for a new use or new people.

ex.en: Our teacher rewrote the play for first graders.
ex.ko: 선생님은 연극을 1학년 학생들에 맞게 각색했다.

easy: A show where cowboys ride wild horses and bulls to show their skills.

ex.en: We saw cowboys ride bulls at the rodeo.
ex.ko: 우리는 로데오에서 카우보이들이 황소를 타는 모습을 보았다.

easy: A very big, strong horse from England that pulls heavy loads.

ex.en: The shire horse pulled the wagon up the hill.
ex.ko: 샤이어 말이 수레를 끌고 언덕을 올라갔다.

easy: A long, thin opening or cut.

ex.en: Light came through a slit in the curtain.
ex.ko: 커튼 틈으로 빛이 들어왔다.

easy: Crying with short, hard breaths.

ex.en: We heard her soft sobbing in the next room.
ex.ko: 우리는 옆방에서 그녀의 나지막한 흐느낌을 들었다.

easy: Very, very hungry.

ex.en: After soccer practice, I was starved.
ex.ko: 축구 연습이 끝나고 나는 배고파 죽을 지경이었다.

easy: Soft material put inside a pillow or toy to make it fat and soft.

ex.en: The stuffing came out of my old teddy bear.
ex.ko: 내 낡은 곰 인형에서 솜이 삐져나왔다.

easy: A person who likes to joke and make fun of others.

ex.en: My big brother is a teaser, but he is kind.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 잘 놀리지만 마음이 따뜻하다.

easy: Liked by many people right now, in the latest style.

ex.en: She wore trendy shoes to school.
ex.ko: 그녀는 유행하는 신발을 신고 학교에 갔다.

easy: Cut a little so it looks neat.

ex.en: Grandpa has a neatly trimmed beard.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 깔끔하게 다듬은 수염을 기르셨다.

easy: Small things that do not matter much.

ex.en: Which color socks you wear is just trivia.
ex.ko: 어떤 색 양말을 신느냐는 사소한 일일 뿐이다.

easy: Moving fast and roughly, like a river after a storm.

ex.en: The river was turbulent after the heavy rain.
ex.ko: 폭우가 내린 뒤 강물이 거세게 소용돌이쳤다.

easy: So bad that you cannot stand it.

ex.en: The heat in the car was unbearable.
ex.ko: 차 안의 더위는 참을 수 없을 정도였다.

easy: Too young by law to do something adults can do.

ex.en: He is underage, so he cannot get a driver's license.
ex.ko: 그는 미성년자라서 운전면허를 딸 수 없다.

easy: Not having a husband or wife.

ex.en: My uncle is unmarried and lives alone.
ex.ko: 우리 삼촌은 미혼이고 혼자 산다.

easy: In a way that is not clear or exact.

ex.en: I vaguely remember my first day of school.
ex.ko: 나는 학교 첫날이 어렴풋이 기억난다.

easy: Water that spins around fast and pulls things into the middle.

ex.en: A vortex of water formed when the tub drained.
ex.ko: 욕조 물이 빠질 때 물의 소용돌이가 생겼다.

easy: A thin stick that a magician or wizard holds to do magic.

ex.en: The wizard waved his wand and a rabbit appeared.
ex.ko: 마법사가 지팡이를 흔들자 토끼가 나타났다.

easy: Made a little hot so it is not cold anymore.

ex.en: I drank a cup of warmed milk before bed.
ex.ko: 나는 자기 전에 따뜻하게 데운 우유를 마셨다.

easy: A made-up name that someone uses instead of their real name.

ex.en: The superhero used an alias at school.
ex.ko: 그 슈퍼히어로는 학교에서 가명을 썼다.

easy: Also called by another name.

ex.en: Clark Kent, alias Superman, works at a newspaper.
ex.ko: 일명 슈퍼맨인 클라크 켄트는 신문사에서 일한다.

easy: A tiny helper in your blood that fights germs.

ex.en: Your body makes antibodies to fight germs.
ex.ko: 우리 몸은 세균과 싸우기 위해 항체를 만든다.

easy: So bad that it shocks and upsets you.

ex.en: The mess in the kitchen was appalling.
ex.ko: 부엌의 어질러진 모습은 끔찍했다.

easy: To clap your hands to show you liked something.

ex.en: Everyone applauded after the school play.
ex.ko: 학교 연극이 끝나자 모두가 박수를 쳤다.

easy: To say that something is very good.

ex.en: The teacher applauded Mia's hard work.
ex.ko: 선생님은 미아의 노력을 칭찬하셨다.

easy: The feeling you get when nothing is fun or interesting.

ex.en: I felt boredom during the long car ride.
ex.ko: 긴 차 여행 동안 나는 지루함을 느꼈다.

easy: A man who is good at shooting arrows with a bow.

ex.en: The bowman hit the middle of the target.
ex.ko: 궁수는 과녁 한가운데를 맞혔다.

easy: In a very bright, shining way.

ex.en: The stars shone brilliantly over the lake.
ex.ko: 별들이 호수 위에서 눈부시게 빛났다.

easy: In a very smart way.

ex.en: She solved the math puzzle brilliantly.
ex.ko: 그녀는 수학 퍼즐을 훌륭하게 풀었다.

easy: A meal you eat late in the morning, like breakfast and lunch together.

ex.en: We had pancakes for brunch on Sunday.
ex.ko: 일요일에 우리는 브런치로 팬케이크를 먹었다.

easy: A dark red color with some purple in it.

ex.en: She wore a burgundy sweater.
ex.ko: 그녀는 버건디색 스웨터를 입었다.

easy: A tall tree that gives hard brown nuts in prickly shells.

ex.en: Squirrels gather nuts under the chestnut tree.
ex.ko: 다람쥐들이 밤나무 아래에서 열매를 모은다.

easy: A store where people take clothes to get them cleaned.

ex.en: Dad took his suit to the cleaners.
ex.ko: 아빠는 양복을 세탁소에 맡겼다.

easy: The fourth place in a baseball batting line, often for the best hitter.

ex.en: Our best slugger plays cleanup.
ex.ko: 우리 팀 최고의 강타자는 4번 타자로 나온다.

easy: To make up a new piece of music.

ex.en: Mozart composed music when he was five.
ex.ko: 모차르트는 다섯 살 때 곡을 지었다.

easy: Short but says everything important.

ex.en: Her concise report was only one page.
ex.ko: 그녀의 간결한 보고서는 겨우 한 쪽이었다.

easy: Very different from each other, so you can easily see the difference.

ex.en: She painted with contrasting colors, black and white.
ex.ko: 그녀는 검정과 흰색처럼 대조되는 색으로 그림을 그렸다.

easy: When two or more things come together at one place.

ex.en: We stood at the convergence of two rivers.
ex.ko: 우리는 두 강이 만나는 곳에 서 있었다.

easy: An amount that is taken away from a total.

ex.en: There was a deduction from my allowance for the broken lamp.
ex.ko: 깨진 램프 때문에 내 용돈에서 돈이 차감되었다.

easy: A talk between two people.

ex.en: I wrote a dialog between a cat and a dog.
ex.ko: 나는 고양이와 개의 대화를 썼다.

easy: The words that the characters say in a play, movie, or book.

ex.en: I memorized my dialog for the school play.
ex.ko: 나는 학교 연극의 대사를 외웠다.

easy: Having to do with breaking down food in your body.

ex.en: Your stomach makes digestive juices.
ex.ko: 위는 소화액을 만든다.

easy: To get smaller or less.

ex.ko: 버스가 멀어지자 소음이 줄어들었다.

easy: To pull out the plug so a machine stops working.

ex.en: Disconnect the TV before the storm comes.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 오기 전에 TV 플러그를 뽑아라.

easy: To take apart two things that were joined.

ex.en: Dad disconnected the hose from the faucet.
ex.ko: 아빠는 수도꼭지에서 호스를 분리했다.

easy: Not fair, because you judge people by the group they belong to.

ex.en: It is wrong to have discriminatory rules for some kids.
ex.ko: 일부 아이들에게만 차별적인 규칙을 두는 것은 옳지 않다.

easy: A person who really loves something and spends time on it.

ex.en: My dad is a baseball enthusiast.
ex.ko: 우리 아빠는 열렬한 야구 팬이다.

easy: A place where people dig in the ground to find old things from the past.

ex.en: We visited an excavation where they found dinosaur bones.
ex.ko: 우리는 공룡 뼈가 발견된 발굴 현장을 방문했다.

easy: A small light you hold in your hand that runs on batteries.

ex.en: I used a flashlight to read under the blanket.
ex.ko: 나는 이불 속에서 손전등으로 책을 읽었다.

easy: Making someone look nice.

ex.en: That blue shirt is very flattering on you.
ex.ko: 그 파란 셔츠는 너한테 정말 잘 어울려.

easy: By using strength or force.

ex.en: The firefighters forcibly opened the stuck door.
ex.ko: 소방관들이 꽉 낀 문을 억지로 열었다.

easy: A ring of flowers or leaves worn or hung for decoration.

ex.en: She wore a garland of daisies in her hair.
ex.ko: 그녀는 머리에 데이지 화관을 썼다.

easy: When the whole world becomes more connected in business and life.

ex.en: Because of globalization, we can buy foods from many countries.
ex.ko: 세계화 덕분에 우리는 여러 나라의 음식을 살 수 있다.

easy: Shown as a chart or picture of numbers.

ex.en: The graphical chart showed how tall our plants grew.
ex.ko: 그래프로 된 도표는 우리 식물이 얼마나 자랐는지 보여 주었다.

easy: A ceremony where people dig the first dirt to start building something.

ex.en: The mayor held a shovel at the groundbreaking of our new school.
ex.ko: 시장님이 새 학교 기공식에서 삽을 들었다.

easy: Putting things together into groups.

ex.en: Grouping the toys by color made cleanup easy.
ex.ko: 장난감을 색깔별로 묶으니 정리가 쉬웠다.

easy: Making you feel ashamed or small.

ex.en: Falling in front of the whole class was humiliating.
ex.ko: 반 전체 앞에서 넘어지는 것은 창피했다.

easy: An artist who draws pictures for books and magazines.

ex.en: The illustrator drew funny animals for the book.
ex.ko: 삽화가는 그 책에 재미있는 동물들을 그렸다.

easy: When things are not equal or steady.

ex.ko: 맥스가 훨씬 무거워서 시소가 균형이 맞지 않았다.

easy: Doing things that people know are wrong.

ex.ko: 도둑질은 비도덕적이다.

easy: Wasting time or effort, so it does not work well.

ex.en: Walking back and forth ten times is inefficient.
ex.ko: 열 번씩 왔다 갔다 하는 것은 비효율적이다.

easy: Made stronger or greater.

ex.en: Intensified training helped the team win.
ex.ko: 강화된 훈련 덕분에 팀이 이겼다.

easy: Not being willing to accept people who think or act differently.

ex.ko: 다르다고 놀리는 것은 편협한 행동이다.

easy: The tenth letter of the Greek alphabet.

ex.en: Kappa is a Greek letter that looks like a K.
ex.ko: 카파는 K처럼 생긴 그리스 문자이다.

easy: A red sauce made from tomatoes that you put on fries.

ex.en: I dip my fries in ketchup.
ex.ko: 나는 감자튀김을 케첩에 찍어 먹는다.

easy: Your family line going back through parents and grandparents.

ex.en: Grandma traced our family's lineage back 200 years.
ex.ko: 할머니는 우리 가문의 혈통을 200년 전까지 거슬러 올라가 알아내셨다.

easy: Having a small hole made through it.

ex.en: She has pierced ears.
ex.ko: 그녀는 귀를 뚫었다.

easy: A hard, unpleasant situation that is difficult to get out of.

ex.ko: 비 오는 날 버스 카드를 잃어버려 그는 곤경에 처했다.

easy: A force that pushes something forward.

ex.en: Rockets need great propulsion to leave Earth.
ex.ko: 로켓이 지구를 떠나려면 강한 추진력이 필요하다.

easy: Pushing something forward.

ex.en: Oars give propulsion to the boat.
ex.ko: 노는 배를 앞으로 나아가게 한다.

easy: To feel and show great happiness.

ex.en: The fans rejoiced when their team won.
ex.ko: 팬들은 팀이 이기자 크게 기뻐했다.

easy: A loud wailing sound that warns people.

ex.en: We heard the fire truck siren.
ex.ko: 우리는 소방차 사이렌 소리를 들었다.

easy: A tiny gray bug that lives in damp places and curls into a ball.

ex.en: I found a slater under a wet rock.
ex.ko: 나는 젖은 돌 밑에서 쥐며느리를 발견했다.

easy: A person who is sleeping.

ex.en: The sleeper did not hear the alarm.
ex.ko: 자고 있는 사람은 알람 소리를 듣지 못했다.
